name: DuMux
description: DuMux is short for DUNE for Multi-{Phase, Component, Scale, Physics, Domain, …} flow, transport and deformation; is a free and open-source simulation framework for coupled flow, transport and deformation processes; is a research code written in C++; is based on the research software framework DUNE (Distributed and Unified Numerics Environment) and technically a DUNE discretization and user module. Its main intention is to provide a sustainable and consistent framework for the implementation and application of model concepts and constitutive relations for coupled flow, transport and deformation processes. DuMux originated in porous-media research, and porous-medium flow remains its largest family of models.
